description: What natural hazards and infrastructure surround this latitude/longitude?. One finished place brief for any point on Earth: historical significant earthquakes, tsunami sources and volcanic eruptions near the point (NOAA NCEI), the admin1 region's USGS M6+ rate since 1900 and its rank, nearby GHCN station warming (1991-2020 vs 1961-1990), country hazard totals, nearest cities, scheduled airports, power plants (capacity by fuel), market places and ports, each with great-circle distance in km. Every block names its source and data date; computed fields are marked as computed by Lilambd. Historical record only, not a hazard model, engineering or legal advice. Routes: /answer (lat*, lon*, radius_km); /nearest (lat*, lon*, kind*, radius_km, scheduled, include_heliports, limit, offset); /coverage. Paid $0.5 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /answer, /nearest, /coverage. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.
